## Use Case / 使用场景

Who needs this behavior, and what task would it support?
哪些用户需要该行为，它帮助完成什么任务？

## Proposed Behavior / 建议行为

Describe inputs, expected visual or analytical output, and interaction behavior. Distinguish an event-rule requirement from a new modelling choice.
说明输入、预期可视化或分析结果及交互行为，区分项目规则要求与新增模型选择。

## Rule Or Model Basis / 规则或模型依据

Provide the official edition, section, competition format, or research evidence where applicable. State unknowns and assumptions.
适用时提供官方版本、章节、赛制或研究依据，并列出未知事项与假设。

## Acceptance / 验收方式

Give a concrete example that would establish the feature works, including distance, motion, camera, accessibility, or performance criteria as relevant.
提供可证明功能有效的具体示例，按需要包含距离、运动、视角、无障碍或性能标准。

## Alternatives / 其他方案

Describe an existing workflow or a smaller change that could meet the same need.
说明现有工作流，或能够满足同一需求的较小改动。
